description: Source code for the BitBuffer class in a QR Code generator library, implementing an appendable sequence of bits with methods for manipulation and cloning.

classes.name: BitBuffer
classes.description: A class representing an appendable sequence of bits (0s and 1s), with methods for appending bits, retrieving bits, converting to bytes, and cloning.

methods.name: BitBuffer
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an empty bit buffer.

methods.name: bitLength
methods.description: Returns the length of the bit sequence.

methods.name: getBit
methods.description: Returns the bit at a specified index.

methods.name: getBytes
methods.description: Returns the bits packed into a byte array in big endian order.

methods.name: appendBits
methods.description: Appends a specified number of low bits of a value to the buffer.

methods.name: appendData
methods.description: Appends bit data from a QrSegment to this buffer.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of this BitBuffer object.
